items.what: What a person sends on the private note form: their name, their note, a star rating (optional), their business name (optional), whether they said it is OK to show it on the website, and the date it was sent
items.where: This website's database, as draft reviews in Reviews > New reviews
items.shared: Emailed to the site's own address (the note email set in Reviews, or the notice address in Business info)
items.when: When someone sends the note form at /review/note/. A note is only shown on the website if the person ticked the OK box.

items.what: A scrambled (hashed) form of the visitor's IP address, with a count of notes sent from it, used to limit notes to five an hour
items.where: A temporary record in this website's database
items.when: When someone sends the private note form.

items.what: A count of visits to the review page, kept as monthly totals by how the link was shared (QR code, text, email, card or plain link). Nothing about the visitor is saved with it.
items.where: This website's database, in the plugin's settings
items.when: When someone opens the review page (/review/). Search engines, link previews and signed-in staff are not counted.

items.what: Public Google reviews of the business, copied from its Google Business Profile: the reviewer's name as Google shows it (or "A Google user"), the review text, star rating, date, and the address of the reviewer's Google profile photo
items.where: This website's database, as reviews. New ones arrive as drafts.
items.kept: Until someone deletes it. A daily sync updates each one from Google. A review removed from Google is taken off the site and kept as a draft.
items.when: Only when Google is connected in the Reviews settings. Reviews with stars but no words are not copied.

items.what: Reviews that site staff copy in by hand from other review sites (such as Yelp, Facebook or BBB): the reviewer's name, the review text, stars, date, a link to the review and an optional reviewer detail
The visitor's IP address and browser details, seen by Google when a review card shows a Google reviewer's photo
items.where: Not kept by this website. The photo loads straight from Google's servers, without telling Google which page it is on.
items.when: When a page shows a Google review that has a profile photo.

items.what: The visitor's IP address and browser details, seen by Google Fonts when the review pages load their fonts
items.when: On the /review/ and /review/note/ pages, when a font from the list is chosen in the Reviews settings (Hanken Grotesk and Geist Mono are the defaults).

notes: Deleting the plugin keeps the reviews, notes and visit totals unless "Remove all reviews and settings when the plugin is deleted" is ticked.
